name: testsmt.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (c Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (b1 Ref)(b2 Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) Ref
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.x: ---

(define-fun A!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.x: ---

(define-fun B.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.y: ---

(define-fun B!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.b1: ---

(define-fun C!b1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (b1 (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.b2: ---

(define-fun C!b2 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (b2 (deref-C this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-C (TopLevelDeclarations!c this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< 0 (A!x this))
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)
(declare-const const-3-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< 0 (B!x this))
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert2))
(assert (! (B.inv1 3) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (B!x this) (B!y this))
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert4))
(assert (! (B.inv2 3) :named _xkassert5))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (C!b1 this))
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 4) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (C!b2 this))
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 4) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun C.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (C!b1 this) (C!b2 this)))
)

(assert (! (C.inv3 4) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun C.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (B.x (C!b1 this)) (B.x (C!b2 this)))
)

(assert (! (C.inv4 4) :named _xkassert9))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
        4 (lift-C const-4-C))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (b2 (sel-C (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-B a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (< 0 (x (sel-B (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (< 0 (x (sel-B (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (< (x (sel-B (select heap 3))) (y (sel-B (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (b1 (sel-C (select heap 4)))))
      (a!2 (select heap (b2 (sel-C (select heap 4))))))
  (< (x (sel-B a!1)) (x (sel-B a!2)))))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 11798 11799))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-C a!1)))
(define-fun const-3-B () B
  (mk-B 11799 11800))
(define-fun const-4-C () C
  (mk-C 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (b1 (sel-C (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-B a!1)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4))
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 1))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (b1 (sel-C (select heap 4))) (b2 (sel-C (select heap 4))))))
  (not a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (< 0 (x (sel-A (select heap 1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (< (x (sel-B (select heap 2))) (y (sel-B (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4)))
                  1
                  (lift-A (mk-A 1)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-B (mk-B 11798 11799)))
                  3
                  (lift-B (mk-B 11799 11800)))))
  (store a!2 4 (lift-C (mk-C 2 3))))))
